Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

DIMENSIONS FOR 
SINTERED CARBIDE PELLETS USED IN HEADING DIES 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and tolerances of sintered carbide pellets used in heading dies.

Note — The tolerances Include a grinding allowance of 0*2 to 0'3 mm on each and dependant on the outside 
diameter and length of the pellet. 



4. Designation — A sintered carbide pellet of 2*10 mm finished bore, 10 mm outside diameter 
and 25 mm length shall be designated as: 

Sintered Carbide Pellet 210 x 10 x 25 IS : 11344 

5. Marking — The pellets shall be marked with the designation and the manufacturer's name or trade- 
mark. 

6. Packing — Sintered pellets shall be packed in suitable cartons to avoid damages during handling 
and transport. 



IS: 11344-1985 

EXPLA N ATOR Y NOTE 

In the preparation of this standard considerable assistance has been derived from ISO 5407-1981 
'As sintered hard metal pellets used in heading dies — Dimension and tolerances' issued by lnternatior\al 
Organization for Standardization, ISO. In comparison with the ISO this standard covers only the Series 
A type of pellets. Pellets of series B type have not been included in this standard as the details of 
washer seating are not specified in the ISO standard.
